title: Embedded AI next-step hints for stuck novice Java programmers
summary: When a novice becomes stuck during an open-ended Java programming task, an expert-designed tool can submit the current code snapshot to an LLM and return one concise next-step hint. The hint is intended to identify the most serious obstacle and support progress without exposing the task solution.

sources.title: Howzat? Appealing to Expert Judgement for Evaluating Human and AI Next-Step Hints for Novice Programmers
sources.evidence_quote: it may be best for a tool, such as an Integrated Development Environment (IDE), to provide the prompt on behalf of the student, in order to generate a hint

assessment.summary: Continue an open-ended Java task with an automatically generated next-step hint based only on the current code snapshot.
student_actions: Develop Java code until help is needed.
Request and interpret a next-step hint.
Revise the code without being given the complete solution.

student_role.description: A tool, rather than the novice, constructs the LLM prompt and displays an expert-designed next-step hint.

assessment_system_role: Infer the likely task from code and generate a pedagogical next-step hint
